in_scope.instructions:
Specifically looking for credentials to Equifax systems that are within Github and accessible.  
In Scope would be credentials to either Internal or External Equifax owned systems.

Not In Scope
Compromised credentials as a component of a "dump", or a component of a consumer system, of any type would not be in Scope.
Information that provides system names and IP addresses that might be considered "Not in Best Practice" will not be considered within scope.
Credentials that are not actually applicable to any Equifax owned system are not in scope.
